rules.statement: Oral evidence is admissible to prove fraud subsequent to the execution of a deed under Ordinance No. 7 of 1840, even though the initial transaction was not fraudulent.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is clear that according to section 2 of Ordinance No. 7 of 1840 oral evidence is inadmissible in cases relating to land, Nachiar v. Fernando (2) . But where there is fraud the proposition may be stated broadly that oral evidence is admissible."
